attacker_pocs.name: mixed_depth_identity
attacker_pocs.why: A public API round trip decodes a valid planar RGB HEIF with an 8-bit R plane, 16-bit G plane, and 8-bit B plane through the identity-matrix RGB-to-YCbCr conversion. The new G stride adjustment counts bytes twice and reads beyond the decoded G plane.

role_a_rationale: The identity-matrix path now uses R's own input stride and Cr's own output stride in both range modes, addressing the reported R-plane out-of-bounds read. A mixed-depth stride adjustment for G introduces a separate out-of-bounds read for an otherwise accepted planar image. The change is confined to the conversion routine and ordinary equal-depth images retain their previous behavior.
